summary: Scorpio Tankers Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing two routine capital management actions: a redemption notice for its 7.5% Senior Unsecured Notes due 2030 ($200 million aggregate principal, make-whole price of 106.4 plus accrued interest, redemption expected July 17, 2026) and a commitment for a $90 million credit facility from Standard Chartered and DekaBank to finance four newbuilding MR tankers. Neither action constitutes a special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The redemption is a standard debt refinancing, and the credit facility is ordinary course financing for vessel acquisitions. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium/discount is relevant. As a non-US issuer reporting under Form 6-K, the filing is routine. What to watch: execution of definitive documentation and vessel deliveries.
